fact: The September 2024 appraisal report says the State's open-source information system is not used, that ANADEN will put its own staff at the project unit's disposal so domestic skills are kept instead of relying on external consultants, and that the national datacentre will be operated by a private provider under a lease.
title: Comorian Economic Digitalisation Support Project (PADEC) - Project Appraisal Report
